description: This source file defines a class 'TimeModuleStatusChangeSubscriber' which subscribes to module status change events within the OrangeHRM system. It handles the event when the 'time' module's status changes, updating relevant permissions for dashboard widgets accordingly.

classes.name: TimeModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: Event subscriber class handling status change events for the 'time' module, updating widget permissions based on module state.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the MODULE_STATUS_CHANGE event to the handler method 'onStatusChangeEvent'.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event, and if the previous module was 'time', updates widget permissions accordingly.
